column1: # Src-family kinases (SFKs) — the family whose three-domain architecture the
# domain overlay draws, and whose autoinhibited structure the contact map
# Eight human SFKs plus the mouse and chicken SRC orthologs. Every member is
# SH3 + SH2 + tyrosine-kinase catalytic domain followed by the regulatory
# C-terminal tail, so the overlay lines the same three boxes up down the
# alignment and the arcs show how they pack against each other.
# Row labels are UniProt entry names, which is what the JBrowse links and
# contacts.mjs name (querySeqName SRC_HUMAN). Human SRC first (reference).
